description: Native AI inference for PHP 8.3+ - run ONNX, GGUF (llama.cpp) and RubixML models directly in your PHP process via FFI. Chat, streaming, embeddings, RAG and vector search. No Python, no HTTP microservices, no Docker sidecars.
